record.reason: DORA is explicitly an asynchronous reinforcement-learning system for language-model training and post-training. Its system contributions concern rollout collection, learner updates, training scalability and training throughput; the primary evaluation does not target inference-time serving or decoding efficiency. It is excluded because the worklist's candidate scope covers inference.
record.title: DORA: A Scalable Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning System for Language Model Training
